title: BOLA / IDOR
attack: BOLA / IDOR. User A reads, updates, or deletes an object owned by user B by swapping the identifier. Test every identifier the route accepts, including nested and in-body ones.
prevent: User A reads, updates or deletes an object owned by user B by swapping any identifier the route accepts, including nested and in-body ones.

title: Broken authentication
attack: Broken authentication. The route answers with no credential, an expired one, a tampered signature, a token issued for another audience/tenant, or one that was revoked.
prevent: The route answers with no credential, an expired one, a tampered signature, a token for another audience/tenant, or a revoked one.

title: Broken function-level authorization
attack: Broken function-level authorization. A low-privilege principal reaches an operation meant for a higher role — including the method nobody guarded (GET protected, DELETE forgotten).
prevent: A low-privilege principal reaches an operation meant for a higher role, including the method nobody guarded.

title: Mass assignment
attack: Mass assignment. A privileged field submitted in the body is persisted — role, is_admin, tenant_id, verified, balance, price, created_by.
prevent: A privileged field submitted in the body is persisted (role, is_admin, tenant_id, verified, balance, price, created_by).

title: Injection
attack: Injection. Untrusted input reaching an interpreter — SQL/NoSQL, command, template, LDAP, or path traversal on any file/path parameter.
prevent: Untrusted input reaches an interpreter: SQL/NoSQL, command, template, LDAP, or path traversal on any file/path parameter.

title: Excessive data exposure
attack: Excessive data exposure. The response body carries fields this caller must not see — password hashes, internal IDs, other users' data, plan/billing internals, soft-deleted rows.
prevent: The response body carries fields this caller must not see (hashes, internal IDs, other users' data, plan/billing internals, soft-deleted rows).

title: Error leakage
attack: Error leakage. A malformed or hostile request returns a stack trace, driver error, file path, or query text.
prevent: A malformed or hostile request returns a stack trace, driver error, file path, or query text.

title: Resource abuse
attack: Resource abuse. No throttle on an expensive or auth-adjacent route; unbounded page size, upload size, or payload depth.
prevent: No throttle on an expensive or auth-adjacent route; unbounded page size, upload size or payload depth.

title: XSS
attack: XSS. A stored or reflected value reaches an HTML, attribute, URL, or script sink and executes. Test what the *server* stores, not just what the form accepts.
prevent: A stored or reflected value reaches an HTML, attribute, URL or script sink and executes. Test what the server stores.

title: Client-side-only authorization
attack: Client-side-only authorization. The UI hides the control, but the underlying request still succeeds when issued directly. The hidden button is not a permission.
prevent: The UI hides the control but the underlying request still succeeds when issued directly.

title: Credential exposure in the client
attack: Credential exposure in the client. Session token in localStorage, a secret/API key inlined into the built bundle, PII in a client-side log.
prevent: Session token in localStorage, a secret/API key inlined into the built bundle, PII in a client-side log.

title: CSRF / unsafe cross-origin state change
attack: CSRF / unsafe cross-origin state change. A state-changing request succeeds without an anti-CSRF token or an equivalent SameSite guarantee.
prevent: A state-changing request succeeds without an anti-CSRF token or an equivalent SameSite guarantee.

title: Unsafe navigation
attack: Unsafe navigation. Open redirect, unvalidated postMessage origin, target="_blank" without rel="noopener".
prevent: Open redirect, unvalidated postMessage origin, target="_blank" without rel="noopener".

title: CORS
attack: CORS. A credentialed request from an unintended origin is accepted — reflected Origin, wildcard with credentials, a too-loose regex.
prevent: A credentialed request from an unintended origin is accepted (reflected Origin, wildcard with credentials, loose regex).

title: Missing security headers
attack: Missing security headers on the surface this change ships — CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, frame-ancestors, HSTS.
prevent: Missing CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, frame-ancestors or HSTS on the surface this change ships.

title: Reachable secret
attack: Reachable secret. A key committed to the repo, baked into a build artifact, or written to a log.
prevent: A key committed to the repo, baked into a build artifact, or written to a log.

title: Cookie flags
attack: Cookie flags. A session cookie set without httpOnly + secure + an explicit SameSite.
prevent: A session cookie set without httpOnly + secure + an explicit SameSite.

title: Unproven identifier as authority
attack: Unproven identifier as authority. An email or phone the caller has not proven spends, redeems, overwrites, claims, receives a privileged grant (including one an admin later gives to an identifier pre-claimed while unverified), or keys a limit. The refusal must not depend on victim data (no balance or existence oracle).
prevent: An email or phone the caller has not proven must not spend, redeem, overwrite, claim, receive a privileged grant, or key a limit, and an identifier pre-claimed while unverified must not inherit authority when a legitimate admin later grants it. Refusal must not depend on victim data, so there is no balance or existence oracle.

title: Outbound message abuse
attack: Outbound message abuse. The platform sends a message or mail to a recipient the caller has not proven, carrying caller-controlled text, with no recipient or tenant cap — including jobs for a suspended tenant that keep sending.
prevent: A platform-sent message or mail to a recipient the caller has not proven, carrying caller-controlled text, needs recipient and tenant caps and must not carry the free text to unverified recipients. Jobs for suspended tenants must not keep sending.

title: Link and token destination trust
attack: Link and token destination trust. A link or token in an outbound message points at a host or origin that is not verified.
prevent: Links or tokens placed in outbound messages must use only a verified host or origin; the platform must never place a token under an unverified host.

title: Shared-resource and fairness abuse under the rate limit
attack: Shared-resource and fairness abuse under the rate limit. Stock or inventory holds, queue head-of-line starvation across tenants, or a guess cap bypassed through an alternate route or an omittable limit key.
prevent: Stock or inventory holds, queue head-of-line starvation across tenants, and guess-cap bypass via alternate routes or omittable limit keys must be bounded by more than a per-caller rate limit.

title: Caller-triggered cost shifting
attack: Caller-triggered cost shifting. An anonymous or low-trust action debits another party's balance, wallet or quota with no economic cap.
prevent: An anonymous or low-trust action must not debit another party's balance, wallet or quota without an economic cap.

title: Lifecycle and transition invariants
attack: Lifecycle and transition invariants. Cancel, expire, suspend, dismiss and pending-attempt states fail to reverse or stop their side effects, or leave stuck or perpetual state; an expired, suspended or closed entity still takes new orders for free.
prevent: Cancel, expire, suspend, dismiss, close and pending-attempt states must reverse or stop their side effects and never leave stuck or perpetual state; an expired, suspended or closed entity must refuse new orders or charge the fee it owes.

title: Server owns derived values, gates and sensitive fields
attack: Server owns derived values, gates and sensitive fields. A client- or role-writable field sets price, fees, payment status, entitlement or a plan gate, without field-level server enforcement, including a value the server derives from a client-set input.
prevent: Client- or role-writable fields that set price, fees, payment status, entitlement or plan gates must be enforced server-side at field level.

title: Session assurance and context at every entry point
attack: Session assurance and context at every entry point. A valid session of insufficient assurance (aal1, recovery) reaches data, or a crafted link replaces a session.
prevent: Valid sessions of insufficient assurance (aal1, recovery) and session replacement via crafted links must not reach data or replace a session.
